notes.title: Version 1.3.2 released
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!


Lets start the year with some bug fixing.
There was a problem with the en passant move, thanks to 
 Harbinger50 for finding it and informing me.

That one is fixed now as well as some minor changes such as a quick overview of the controls in the options menu.

If you encounter any other issues do let me know!

notes.title: Version 1.3. released
notes.notes:
Thanks for the help with testing v1.3!

As of now ChessVR supports the oculus rift as well with a gamepad as well as some achievments!

But there are a few things more as well.

Check it out and let me know what you think!

Changelog:

ADDED: UCI support, comes by default with stockfish but you can replace that (if your prefered engine doesn't seem to work tell me which one and I'll look into it).

ADDED: Challenges, try yourself at some chess puzzles (All of them require you to win in 2 moves)

ADDED: Gamepad support

ADDED: Steam achievements

ADDED: Free movement, if you don't like the default position you can change that now (touchpad on vive controller, wasd eq, right stick/rb/lb on gamepad)

ADDED: Turn indicator, the players base lights up

ADDED: Speed up animation if you don't want to wait for the whole animation (grip button/spacebar/"X" on gamepad)

FIXED: Corrected white/black selection

FIXED: Bishop/Queen animation

notes.title: Version 1.2 released
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

today the new update is finally ready.
All models and animations are updated to really bring the game to life.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25436224/2ae5ac6df33b2968ea3983e95b49fbd5db6c701e.png

Let me know how you like it and if you expierence any problems or found bugs.

The big thing for the next update is gonna be UCI-support so you can use whatever chess engine you prefer as long as it supports UCI (most noteably probably stockfish) as this was requested by a lot of you guys.
